about.title: Vision & mission
about.vision: To become an Islamic educational institution that successfully shapes a generation of noble character, broad knowledge, and the ability to integrate Islamic values into modern life for the progress of the community and the nation.
about.mission: To provide holistic and integrated education, combining traditional religious curriculum with contemporary knowledge.
about.body: Pondok Pesantren Selaparang remains committed to developing the whole person through integrated education — learning that follows the formal curriculum while staying rooted in the values of the pesantren.

principles.p1: Faith and noble conduct come before achievement.
principles.p2: Religious knowledge and contemporary knowledge strengthen each other.
principles.p3: Education forms character as well as intellect.
principles.p4: Teachers lead by example, in words and in daily practice.
principles.p5: Service to the community is part of every student's learning.

about.body1: Minimals started from an observation: every production Flask service re-implements the same scaffolding — auth, CSRF, roles, migrations, health checks, a frontend build. Minimals packages that floor, and nothing above it.
about.body2: The architecture is deliberately boring. Services own transactions, repositories own queries, and the wire format is a tested contract. When something breaks, you fix it at the point of failure — there is no history to dig through.

features.title: Everything you'd build anyway
features.lead: The production floor every Flask service needs — included, tested, and deliberately unexciting.

layered.title: Layered domains
layered.desc: Seven files per domain, dependencies pointing only downward. A bug has exactly one address.

auth.title: Session & API-key auth
auth.desc: Browser sessions via Flask-Login; services authenticate with bcrypt-hashed API keys behind a 10-char lookup prefix.

security.title: Security defaults
security.desc: CSRF on every write, per-IP rate limits, CSP + HSTS, and forwarded headers believed only from private peers.

roles.title: Roles & RBAC
roles.desc: A hard-coded app role for real checks, relational roles for labels, and require_role helpers that return.

setup.title: First-run setup
setup.desc: SQLite, MariaDB or PostgreSQL: test, migrate, create the admin — the engine hot-swaps, loopback-only.

health.title: Health & audit
health.desc: /health and /ready probes, rotating logs, an audit trail per write, and alerts that never break the business flow.

spa.title: Vue 3 SPA included
spa.desc: frappe-ui on Tailwind tokens, built straight into Flask's static folder. One process, one origin, one deploy.

migrations.title: Migrations on boot
migrations.desc: Flip MIGRATE_ON_BOOT and Alembic runs before the server accepts traffic — schema and models stay in step across engines.

cta.title: Start where the boring parts are already done.
cta.lead: Run setup once — point at your database, create the admin — then ship your domain on a floor that's ready.
